rundown: Jets beat Devils 4-2 at Canada Life Centre in Winnipeg in front of 15,209. It was level at 2-2 after two periods. The 1st period decided it: Jets won it 2-0.
6 goals in all. Jets's last: Kyle Connor Goal Wrist Shot, assists: none, 3rd period 19:02.
Leading the way — Devils: Cody Glass 1 goal, 1 pts; Declan Chisholm 1 ast. Jets: Kyle Connor 2 goals, 2 pts; Cole Perfetti 2 ast.
Where Jets won it: they outshot them 25-21, scored 2 on the power play to 0 and out-hit them 22-8.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Devils closed as 1.5-goal favorites and lost outright to Jets; Jets won as the underdog at +120; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 6, under by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 6:58 PM ET. It had Devils 53% and Jets 47%, projecting Devils 3.1 – Jets 2.9 (6 total, Devils by 0.2).

Final: Devils 2 – Jets 4. Wrong winner: it had Devils at 53%, and Jets (47%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Devils came in with a league-average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (13-5-0, 3.7 scored and 2.8 allowed a game over 18 games), worth about 77 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.1, they scored 2 (−1.1 goals, 36% under); projected to allow 2.9, they allowed 4 (+1.1 goals, 37% over).

Jets came in with a 6% below average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (7-8-3, 2.7 scored and 3.5 allowed a game over 18 games), worth about 77 and 77 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.9, they scored 4 (+1.1 goals, 37% over); projected to allow 3.1, they allowed 2 (−1.1 goals, 36% under).

The bigger miss was Devils' scoring (-1.1 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 6 against 6 projected (0), about the 49th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Jets by 2 against Devils by 0.2 projected, about the 81st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
WPG ML (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 45% vs 44% fair (+1.1 pts) — won (+1.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 44%). NJ ML (-142) at -142: the algo gave it 55% vs 56% fair (-1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 56%). WPG +1.5 (-205) at -205: the algo gave it 67% vs 64% fair (+2.4 pts) — won (+0.5u); same number as the close. NJ -1.5 (+170) at +170: the algo gave it 33% vs 36% fair (-2.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 47% vs 49% fair (-2.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 53% vs 51% fair (+2.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network + DraftKings): spread: 56% of bets on Devils, 89% of the money — Jets covered; total: 76% of bets on the over, 90% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 88% of bets on Devils, 87% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Devils, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.968 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +2.3 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 41 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.972 and gives home teams +0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Devils attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games); Jets attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
